infra-terraform.README.md:
# Infrastructure (Terraform)

Terraform modules for VPC, EKS, RDS and the observability stack, across
`dev`, `staging` and `prod` workspaces.

## Layout

```
modules/
  vpc/
  eks/
  rds/
  observability/
environments/
  dev/
  staging/
  prod/
```

## State

Remote state in S3 with DynamoDB locking. Concurrent applies to the same
workspace corrupt the lock entry — pipelines serialise via a concurrency group
per workspace (OPS-64).

## Certificates

Internal gateway certificates are issued by cert-manager and renew
automatically at 30 days remaining (OPS-51). Nothing here should be issued by
hand any more.

mobile-client.README.md:
# Mobile Client

Android client, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Default branch is `develop`;
releases are cut from `main`.

## Build

```bash
./gradlew assembleDebug
```

## Design tokens

Consumes `@example-corp/design-tokens`, published from `web-frontend`. The
pinned version currently trails the web application by four releases, which is
why spacing and colour diverge — tracked as WEB-19.

## Release process

1. Merge to `develop`
2. Cut a release branch, run the visual regression suite
3. Tag from `main` after sign-off

platform-api.README.md:
# Platform API

Core REST and event APIs backing the platform. Spring Boot 3.3, Java 21,
deployed to EKS via the manifests in `infra-terraform`.

## Modules

| Module | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `api-core` | Domain model and service layer |
| `api-rest` | HTTP surface, OpenAPI definitions |
| `api-events` | Kafka producers and consumers |
| `api-delivery` | Outbound webhook delivery and retry |

## Local development

```bash
./gradlew bootRun --args='--spring.profiles.active=local'
```

Requires Postgres 16 and Redpanda; `docker compose up -d` brings both up.

## Webhook delivery

Outbound delivery uses an exponential backoff with 8 attempts over roughly
45 minutes. The attempt counter lives on the delivery record, **not** on the
circuit breaker — see OPS-42 for why that distinction matters.

## Conventions

API definitions are linted against the shared Spectral ruleset on every pull
request (PLAT-27). Mutating endpoints require an `Idempotency-Key` header
(PLAT-31).

web-frontend.README.md:
# Web Frontend

Customer-facing React application and the `@example-corp/design-tokens`
package consumed by both this app and the Android client.

## Getting started

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

## Structure

```
src/
  app/          routes and layouts
  features/     checkout, search, account
  design/       tokens, primitives, theming
  lib/          api client, session handling
```

## Theming

Light and dark palettes are generated from the same token set. Contrast is
validated in CI against WCAG AA — see WEB-11 for the outstanding dark-mode
failures, which are being fixed at the token level rather than per component.

## Session handling

Sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity. Long-running forms warn at two
minutes remaining and offer a silent refresh (WEB-22).
